$comment: Record id prefixes that were retired in favour of another prefix. A record id's prefix is its brand slug (vocab/manufacturers.json, organizations.slug). Machine tools (the SDK's normalizeRecordId, Genie, tools/seed-registry.mjs) rewrite a retired prefix to its current one; the website's publish and submission routes reject an id whose prefix isn't the brand slug; the database rejects it too (id_prefix_mismatch, 0013). The registry keeps redirects from the old ids (0012_record_id_redirects.sql, 0013_record_id_cleanup.sql). Only add an entry together with a rename migration and redirects.
